description: Rate-VMAF points of MCV2, H.264, VP9 and AV1, and what dithered maps send, on the 1080p30 Minecraft proxy and on real Minecraft gameplay; measured 2026-09-28 for the MCV2 chapter of the docs (results.md, 'The codec comparison' and 'Dithered maps').

proxy30.what: the research's deterministic procedural Minecraft proxy, 1920x1080, frames 0, 2, ..., 58 of its 60 fps second (the 1080p30 frontier's source)
proxy30.regenerate: frames 0, 2, ..., 58 of frame('minecraft_proxy', i, 1920, 1080) of the research repository's mcvideo/sources.py at commit 85445433 (seed 20260915), as raw RGB24; not part of mcav

gameplay30.what: real Minecraft gameplay: frames 120 to 239 of Xiph's Twitch MINECRAFT.y4m (1920x1080, 60 fps; the excerpt's y4m SHA-256 9053e412099066f33f1ce002e83fef891522ac4a0a786a0cbe8757311c227fac), converted to RGB24 by ffmpeg (SHA-256 f69ab4023019be371f123c8b813b1426828e4bd2eeb0446b11642ac5c2f81a57), then every second frame: 60 frames at 30 fps
gameplay30.regenerate: $FFMPEG -i MINECRAFT_excerpt.y4m -fps_mode passthrough -pix_fmt rgb24 -f rawvideo gameplay60.rgb, then frames 0, 2, ..., 118 of it; https://media.xiph.org/video/derf/twitch/y4m/MINECRAFT.y4m

ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.0.2-static https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/  Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers
vmaf_method: the frontier's filter: both raw RGB24 inputs converted to yuv420p, [dis][ref]libvmaf with the default vmaf_v0.6.1 model; the pooled mean and the per-frame minimum; the distorted pictures decoded to raw RGB24 first
codec_method: tools/mcv2/codec_curves.py: each codec's constant-quality mode at the listed CRF, from raw RGB24 into yuv420p, decoded back to raw RGB24 with -fps_mode passthrough, then scored; container_mbps is the file's size over the clip's duration
mcv2_method: tools/mcv2/rate_quality.py --main Mcv2Bench (tools/mcv2/Mcv2Bench.java) with profile=DEFAULT threads=12 budget=true verify=false at each lambda: MCV2's encoder at its DEFAULT preset (only the lambda changes), 'decoded' pictures scored with the frontier's filter; map_mbps is the transport's charge (rows x 128 + 18 bytes a page), zlib_mbps deflates every page's map colours at zlib's default level and adds the 18-byte envelope
mcv2_command: python3 tools/mcv2/rate_quality.py --classpath CLASSPATH --main Mcv2Bench --source $SRC --frames N --fps 30 --lambdas L1,L2,... --ffmpeg $FFMPEG --out points.json -- profile=DEFAULT threads=12 budget=true verify=false
dither_method: tools/mcv2/DitherBench.java: every frame dithered with mcav's DitherAlgorithm and sent by DeltaMapEncoder (what CompressedMapResult sends a viewer who watches from the start) within its budget per frame (131072 bytes, the plugin's default, or 0: every change); 600 frames, the source looped forward and back, the first 120 (the wall filling) left out; map_mbps counts every patch's colours plus MapLayout.PATCH_OVERHEAD (16 bytes), zlib_mbps the colours deflated at zlib's default level plus the same overhead; vmaf compares the pictures the viewer's maps show with the source frames they belong to; algorithm filter_lite is DitherAlgorithm.filterLite(), temporal is DitherAlgorithm.temporalFloydSteinberg()
dither_command: javac -cp CLASSPATH -d build/bench tools/mcv2/DitherBench.java; java -cp build/bench:CLASSPATH DitherBench source=$SRC width=1920 height=1080 frames=600 warm=120 fps=30 loop=pingpong algorithm=filter_lite budget=131072 decoded=dithered.rgb reference=reference.rgb
mcv2_version2_method: tools/mcv2/rate_quality.py --main Mcv2Bench (tools/mcv2/Mcv2Bench.java) with profile=ship threads=12 budget=true verify=false at each lambda: version 2 of MCV2 (the code before it was simplified) with the reference search of its shipped profiles (only the lambda changes), 'decoded' pictures scored with the frontier's filter; map_mbps is the transport's charge (rows x 128 + 18 bytes a page), zlib_mbps deflates every page's map colours at zlib's default level and adds the 18-byte envelope
mcv2_version2_live_method: the same for version 2 of MCV2 (the code before it was simplified) at its live profile (profile=live), the live search MCV2's DEFAULT preset descends from
